chalisa.do1: As the Himālaya is immovable and as Sumeru is unshakable,
so Kubera stands unmoving at the gate of heaven.
chalisa.do2: Remover of obstacles, bringer of good, hear the cry of one who has come for refuge;
for your devotee, give out heaps of wealth and riches.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory, victory to Śrī Kubera, keeper of the treasury; you are the master of wealth and riches.
chalisa.cau2: You are a mass of austerity and splendour, fearless, remover of fear; you are swift as the wind, well-proportioned in body, and mighty.
chalisa.cau3: You keep guard over the gate of heaven; you are the obedient servant of Indra.
chalisa.cau4: You have a great army of yakṣas and yakṣiṇīs; in battle you become their commander, bow in hand.
chalisa.cau5: Becoming a great warrior, you take up weapons; you fight and strike down the enemy.
chalisa.cau6: You are ever victorious and never defeated; you ward off the troubles of your devotees.
chalisa.cau7: The Creator himself, Brahmā, is your great-grandfather; born in the line of Pulastya, you are renowned.
chalisa.cau8: Viśravā is your father and Iḍaviḍā your mother; the devotee Vibhīṣaṇa is your brother.
chalisa.cau9: When you fixed your meditation on Śiva's feet, you performed fierce austerities and wasted your body away.
chalisa.cau10: You received Śiva's boon and attained godhood; you drank nectar, and your body became immortal.
chalisa.cau11: You always hold the banner of dharma in your hand; all the gods and goddesses go about with you.
chalisa.cau12: You wear yellow garments on your body; among the race of yakṣas, your strength and power are complete.
chalisa.cau13: You are seated on a golden throne; a trident and a mace grace your hands.
chalisa.cau14: Conches, mṛdaṅgas and kettledrums sound; the gandharvas' melodies ring out in sweet voices.
chalisa.cau15: The sixty-four yoginīs sing songs of blessing; Ṛddhi and Siddhi set food offerings before you every day.
chalisa.cau16: Men and women servants turn the royal parasol over your head; yakṣas and yakṣiṇīs together wave the fly-whisk.
chalisa.cau17: As among sages Paraśurāma is mighty, as among gods Hanumān is mighty,
chalisa.cau18: as among men Bhīma is mighty, so among yakṣas Kubera is mighty.
chalisa.cau19: As among devotees Prahlāda is great, as among birds Garuḍa is great,
chalisa.cau20: as among serpents Śeṣa is great, so great is Kubera the devotee.
chalisa.cau21: A bow is on his shoulder and a spear in his hand; round his neck he wears a garland of flowers.
chalisa.cau22: He has a golden crown and a large body; light spreads far and wide.
chalisa.cau23: Whoever holds Lord Kubera in his heart is ever victorious and never defeated.
chalisa.cau24: All his spoilt affairs come right, and his stores of grain and wealth stay full.
chalisa.cau25: Kubera himself raises up the poor; Kubera swiftly clears debts.
chalisa.cau26: Kubera wards off his devotee's troubles; Kubera strikes down the enemy in a moment.
chalisa.cau27: Whoever wishes to grow rich quickly, why should he not win the favour of Kubera the yakṣa?
chalisa.cau28: Whoever reads this recitation and has others read it makes his trade grow twofold day by day.
chalisa.cau29: Kubera drives away ghosts and spirits; Kubera brings a stalled task to completion.
chalisa.cau30: Kubera destroys disease and grief; Kubera removes disgrace and leprosy.
chalisa.cau31: Kubera raises higher one who has risen; Kubera lifts up again one who has fallen.
chalisa.cau32: Kubera at once awakens one's fortune; Kubera shows the way to one who has lost it.
chalisa.cau33: Kubera quenches the thirst of the thirsty; Kubera ends the hunger of the hungry.
chalisa.cau34: Kubera lessens the illness of the sick; Kubera frees the sorrowful from sorrow.
chalisa.cau35: Kubera fills the lap of a childless woman; Kubera makes business grow.
chalisa.cau36: Kubera frees from prison; Kubera protects from thieves and swindlers.
chalisa.cau37: Kubera brings victory in a court case to whoever meditates on Kubera in his heart.
chalisa.cau38: Kubera brings victory in elections; Kubera seats one in a minister's office.
chalisa.cau39: Whoever recites it daily with his mind upon it, his powers ever grow by a quarter more.
chalisa.cau40: He with whom Kubera's mother is pleased lives a life full of happiness.
chalisa.cau41: Whoever has Kubera's recitation performed, Kubera carries his boat to the far shore.
chalisa.cau42: He settles a ruined home once more, and makes even an enemy a friend.
chalisa.cau43: Whoever has a thousand books given away receives every happiness, enjoyment and good thing.
chalisa.cau44: Giving up his life-breath, he goes to heaven. The Mānas Parivāra has sung Kubera's glory.
chalisa.do3: Śrī Kubera, king of the yakṣas, foremost among Śiva's devotees:
fill the heart with the light of knowledge and drive away the darkness.
chalisa.do4: Drive away the darkness now; do not delay a moment.
I lie at your refuge: turn your merciful gaze on me.
